meta.source: ti.com Polaris CSS tokens (Oct 2026), TI's 2026 corporate deck theme, media-resources logo files; scaffolding from The Hoffman Agency design system v2.21.0 (brand-agnostic parts only)

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: TI red. The logo mark, primary and secondary buttons, the accent link colour and the error colour on ti.com. As text only on `white`, `grey-050`, `grey-100` (5.9:1); never as text on dark surfaces or on `grey-200`+ tints.

tokens.name: red-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and focus fill of a red button (ti.com `--pl-button-primary-color-hover`). Fill only, white text on it (4.6:1).

tokens.name: red-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of a red button and the dark end of ti.com's red section gradient. White text on it (8.1:1).

tokens.name: red-deck
tokens.usage: The red of the 2026 corporate deck template (theme `dk2`/`accent1`): slide titles and the footer rule. Keep it when extending that deck; new work uses `red`.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: ti.com link and tertiary-button colour. Light theme on `white` (4.9:1) and `grey-100` (4.6:1) only — never below 14px, never on darker tints.

tokens.name: teal-dark
tokens.usage: ti.com tertiary-darker: pressed tertiary button text, teal icons that must clear 4.5:1 on tints. As text on `white` (8.9:1) and `grey-100` (8.3:1).

tokens.name: teal-light
tokens.usage: ti.com tertiary-lighter: the focus halo (`focus-halo`) and tinted charts. Never text (1.7:1 on white).

tokens.name: teal-deck
tokens.usage: The 2026 deck's accent3: line icons, bold inline emphasis, portfolio rules and labels. As text on `white` (5.2:1); on `grey-100` (4.9:1).

tokens.name: teal-deck-500
tokens.usage: Deck mid teal: charts and diagram fills alongside `teal-deck`. Fill only; not as text on light surfaces (3.7:1).

tokens.name: teal-deck-400
tokens.usage: Deck light teal: chart series, map callouts. Fill only; `ink-strong` text on it.

tokens.name: teal-deck-300
tokens.usage: The deck's accent5: callout boxes, secondary chart series, the Taiwan-site map. Fill only; `ink-strong` text on it (2.3:1 for white — never white text).

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Deck body copy (theme `dk1`), the wordmark in the signature, the deep end of ti.com's tertiary section gradient.

tokens.name: grey-900
tokens.usage: ti.com primary text (`--pl-text-color-primary`), secondary borders, the grey line-icon set.

tokens.name: grey-700
tokens.usage: ti.com secondary element colour: input icons, focused input border. As text on `white` (7.5:1).

tokens.name: grey-600
tokens.usage: ti.com input placeholder colour. The lightest grey that still reads as text on `white` (4.5:1).

tokens.name: grey-500
tokens.usage: ti.com input borders at rest. Borders and dividers only (3.0:1 on white — the UI-boundary floor).

tokens.name: grey-400
tokens.usage: ti.com disabled text and disabled input icons. Disabled states only; never for readable text.

tokens.name: grey-300
tokens.usage: ti.com primary divider and disabled element fill.

tokens.name: grey-200
tokens.usage: ti.com secondary divider, input hover and disabled backgrounds, tertiary borders.

tokens.name: grey-100
tokens.usage: ti.com secondary page background and raised-container variant: alternate sections, table stripes, muted wells.

tokens.name: grey-050
tokens.usage: The light end of ti.com's primary section gradient. A whisper of a tint behind a full-width section.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: The page. TI composes on white: web pages, every content slide, print.

tokens.name: grey-deck-caption
tokens.usage: The deck's `lt2`: icon captions and small labels on slides. 3.9:1 on white — captions at 24px+ (9pt) only, never body copy.

tokens.name: grey-deck-dark
tokens.usage: The deck's accent4: dark grey text and shapes on slides. As text on `white` (10.4:1).

tokens.name: grey-deck-mid
tokens.usage: The deck's accent6: neutral chart series and dividers. Fills and rules, not text.

tokens.name: grey-deck-light
tokens.usage: The deck's accent2: light chart series, muted shapes. Fills only.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: ti.com success colour. Icons, fills and badges with a word beside them; 3.4:1 on white, so never text alone — pair with `ink`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: ti.com warning colour. Fills and icons only (1.9:1 on white); `ink-strong` text on it. Always with a word or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: ti.com error colour is TI red. Error text follows the `red` text rule; error borders are 1px `red`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. TI composes on white; v1 of this system has no dark theme (no reversed signature exists yet).

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section, table stripe, muted well. One step from `surface`, never two.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on `surface-alt` (light) or on `surface` (dark). Cards keep a 1px `line` border; no shadow by default.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and labels on `surface`, `surface-alt` and `surface-raised` (12.6:1).

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Deck body copy and the wordmark half of the signature. On slides TI sets body text in pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on `surface` and `surface-raised` (4.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled text and controls. Not expected to pass contrast; pair with a disabled cursor and `aria-disabled`.

tokens.name: ink-on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `red`, `red-hover`, `red-active` fills (5.9:1 / 4.5:1 / 8.1:1). Also the title colour on a full `red` or `teal-deck` divider slide.

tokens.name: ink-on-teal
tokens.usage: Text on `teal`, `teal-dark` and `teal-deck` fills (4.9:1 / 8.9:1 / 5.2:1). On `teal-deck-300`/`teal-light` fills use `ink-strong` instead.

tokens.name: title
tokens.usage: Slide titles and section headings on decks (the 2026 template sets them in `red-deck`; new decks use `red`).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and tertiary buttons. On `surface`/`surface-raised` only (4.9:1).

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover/active (ti.com tertiary active #006774 rounds to `teal-dark`). Underline on hover, 1px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent per surface: primary button, key stat, the emphasised word in a headline, the footer rule. One red object per slide or section.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Primary divider and card border: 1px solid. 3.0:1 against `surface` (the UI-boundary floor).

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Soft divider between rows and list items. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Table header rules, the hairline under a slide title block, the 1px border on a reversed button.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Input and select borders at rest (ti.com `--pl-input-border-color`). Focus switches to `control-border-focus`.

tokens.name: control-border-focus
tokens.usage: Focused input border (ti.com `--pl-input-border-color-focus`) with the `focus-halo` outside it.

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: ti.com's 3px focus halo (`box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px`). The halo is a courtesy; the `focus-ring` carries the 3:1 obligation.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Chosen for this system (ti.com's outline colour is browser default): a solid 2px ring, offset 2px, on every surface (12.6:1 on white).

families.sans: Arial, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "Arial Nova", "Nimbus Sans", sans-serif
families.cjk: Arial, "Noto Sans TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", "PingFang TC", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headlines on ti.com landing sections. Weight 300 — TI's web headlines are light, never bold.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title, once per page; margin-bottom 48px. `ink`, sentence case.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section heading; margin-bottom 32px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-section heading; margin-bottom 16px.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Card and panel heading; margin-bottom 12px.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Label-weight heading inside a card or list; the first bold step of the scale.

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: Small bold heading, table headers, form-section labels.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Our 80,000 products are the essential building blocks of all types of electronics systems.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and long reads. Measure 60–70 characters.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Easy and convenient product search, support and ordering, available 24/7.
styles.usage: ti.com's default body size. UI copy, tables, cards.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, legal lines, metadata. In `ink-muted`; never smaller than this on screen.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: All buttons: 600 weight, sentence case, min-height 40px (compact 32px).

styles.name: link
styles.usage: Inline link in `link`; underline appears on hover.

styles.name: deck-cover
styles.sample: TI company, products and systems overview
styles.usage: Cover title (the template's 30pt). As large as fits on two lines; `title` colour; bottom-left of the cover.

styles.name: deck-title
styles.sample: Great products, engineering expertise and support
styles.usage: Slide title, 24pt in the template, Arial Bold, `title` red, top-left in a 1776 × 128px block, one or two authored lines. Line height 85% as the master sets it.

styles.name: deck-subtitle
styles.sample: We bring together the world's smartest people – problem-solvers known simply as TIers.
styles.usage: The one lead sentence under a title (16pt). `ink-strong`. ≤ 30 words.

styles.name: deck-section-label
styles.usage: Centred strip labels over a hairline (14pt). Letter-spacing 0.18em when uppercase; `teal-deck` or `ink`.

styles.name: deck-body-lg
styles.sample: Exciting and challenging projects and the opportunity to work with some of the world's brightest people
styles.usage: Card and column copy on airy slides (14pt). Bold phrase in `teal-deck` for the lead-in.

styles.name: deck-body
styles.sample: In-house manufacturing capacity, process and package technologies for optimized designs
styles.usage: The template's most-used size (12pt). Body on dense slides, bullets, table cells. The floor for body copy.

styles.name: deck-caption
styles.usage: Icon captions and axis labels (10pt) in `grey-deck-caption` or `ink`. Never for a sentence.

styles.name: deck-caption-sm
styles.usage: Footnotes and sources (9pt). The smallest type allowed on a slide; prefer speaker notes.

styles.name: deck-stat
styles.usage: Hero number (28pt) in `title` red or `ink-strong`, with a `deck-caption` label beneath. Max three per slide, one hero.

styles.name: deck-stat-xl
styles.usage: The one giant figure on an anniversary or milestone slide (33pt). White on `red` or `red` on white.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Web values are ti.com's own margins and paddings; deck values are px on a 1920 × 1080 canvas.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pagination gap (ti.com `--ti_p-pagination-gap`).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a button's icon and label; compact button inline padding; stacked label-to-field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input inline padding (ti.com `--pl-input-padding-inline`); margin under h4–h6.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button inline padding; card padding on mobile; margin under h3; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; column gutter; icon size in icon-text rows (ti.com 24px).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Slide-content inline padding on ti.com carousels; the 28px icon offset in icon-text rows.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Margin under h2; block gap inside a section; stacked margin under a primary button.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Margin under h1; gap between blocks; section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (minimum).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero and feature-section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: deck-margin
tokens.usage: Safe margin on every slide edge: the template places its title block 49px from the left and top edges. Page chrome lives inside it; only imagery bleeds past it.

tokens.name: deck-gutter
tokens.usage: Gap between columns and cards on a slide.

tokens.name: deck-footer
tokens.usage: Height of the footer band: the template's red rule sits 102px above the bottom edge; the signature sits centred in the band, right-aligned inside `deck-margin`.

tokens.name: deck-rule-inset
tokens.usage: The footer rule starts at the left edge of the slide and STOPS 45px (0.235 in) short of the right edge, flush with the right edge of the signature below it. It never runs edge to edge; the open right end is TI's signature move.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width on ti.com (its desktop breakpoint is min-width 1240px; tablet 767–1239; mobile ≤766).

radius.note: TI is square. ti.com's buttons and inputs carry a 2px radius; cards and sections have none.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default: cards, panels, sections, images, slide shapes, tables.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs (ti.com `.ti-button`, `.ti-input`).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tooltips and popovers only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tag chips (ti.com tags use 24px/2em on a 24px tag — a full pill).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars, icon circles, the donut chart's ring, the award roundels on slides.

shadow.note: ti.com's elevation set (Material-derived). Cards at rest have none — a `line` border does the work; shadows belong to menus, drawers and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Hover lift on a tappable card; sticky header.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, autocomplete panels.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Popovers, side sheets, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-4
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: ti.com's focus halo on inputs and buttons; pair with the `focus-ring` outline, which carries the contrast.

border.note: Widths. ti.com draws boundaries with 1px lines; the deck with 2px rules.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers, input borders, table rules.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Web rules and the focus ring width. On slides the red footer rule is heavier: 2.25pt in the template (6px at 1920), see `deck-rule-weight`.

tokens.name: deck-rule-weight
tokens.usage: Weight of the red footer rule on a 1920 × 1080 slide (the template's 2.25pt line). Red, left edge to `deck-rule-inset`.

tokens.name: border-emphasis
tokens.usage: The focus halo width; a highlighted table column.

size.note: Fixed control and asset sizes from ti.com and the deck.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Default button and input height (ti.com `--pl-input-height`, `--ti_c-button-minHeight`).

tokens.name: control-height-compact
tokens.usage: Compact button and inline input height.

tokens.name: control-min-width
tokens.usage: Minimum button width (compact: 72px).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icon inside a button (ti.com `--ti_c-button-iconSize`).

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Inline icon beside text; nav icons.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Feature icon in an icon-text row (ti.com 36px).

tokens.name: icon-deck
tokens.usage: Line icon above a caption on a slide (the template draws them 110–140px tall).

tokens.name: logo-min-web
tokens.usage: Horizontal signature never narrower than this on screen (the mark's 'ti' must stay legible); ti.com's header sets it 280 × 36.

tokens.name: logo-deck
tokens.usage: Signature width in the slide footer, right-aligned inside `deck-margin`.
